### Why Hangovers Can Last Two Days

- **Heavy or repeated drinking:** Consuming a lot of alcohol—or drinking on consecutive nights—overwhelms your body and extends recovery time.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF10UmqLeFKhHH13pKVYqbtJpy6hu6V0lvOpsK-XkaeCTWASHqmTx0aICImkuCvDf02xIEfVpU1gmfl-Znu3oglJWBg2d7_9D1hxQ5UETpKVDPYjN0LUVo34bblWbm8AKgC-7N7f3AgHtNxUTwNuFEIwz7dQMD1TiXUtcMyeI5qbLaxB0WO1GjvuYlEQVTOdQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF16IUyzWty7LnebKgE-4aM-ylQ19USBealrtmYHMjHts_QuhVMVZPAo8er8-Q2q4VH4JZLjHE9Q2yJXrvhyvsfGEjX75GjMHFV4H_4LJ8R52pGy8vw3Tq4P2ZZbwxK8qE6RS_yxiFM9M8Bg2rzmqrFRhxtxMUeNOnENPdM7WefZysGNt2XgSnjnd3grmDcgsunj8fdniTgGaK62MQADcjHruf9b9hp6Smet5zVXvLKOuGtqxgC5ln984)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXqiNNpoyUjH4aKj3jlChIENQXS3X3Rf49MB7rBqcp0QygsB1dqfODqi3quawPIBc2U8NdHK93KGCT6g2nla1uNQwQyc4Ri-gZP5VAp-E3IYiTOCAoXjtpl89MN9F05wctCcyNyRl1DQmamfue___-T8ltRjW7PA)
- **Dehydration and stomach irritation:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic and irritates the stomach lining, leading to ongoing fluid loss, headaches, and nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXqiNNpoyUjH4aKj3jlChIENQXS3X3Rf49MB7rBqcp0QygsB1dqfODqi3quawPIBc2U8NdHK93KGCT6g2nla1uNQwQyc4Ri-gZP5VAp-E3IYiTOCAoXjtpl89MN9F05wctCcyNyRl1DQmamfue___-T8ltRjW7PA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF16IUyzWty7LnebKgE-4aM-ylQ19USBealrtmYHMjHts_QuhVMVZPAo8er8-Q2q4VH4JZLjHE9Q2yJXrvhyvsfGEjX75GjMHFV4H_4LJ8R52pGy8vw3Tq4P2ZZbwxK8qE6RS_yxiFM9M8Bg2rzmqrFRhxtxMUeNOnENPdM7WefZysGNt2XgSnjnd3grmDcgsunj8fdniTgGaK62MQADcjHruf9b9hp6Smet5zVXvLKOuGtqxgC5ln984)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF10UmqLeFKhHH13pKVYqbtJpy6hu6V0lvOpsK-XkaeCTWASHqmTx0aICImkuCvDf02xIEfVpU1gmfl-Znu3oglJWBg2d7_9D1hxQ5UETpKVDPYjN0LUVo34bblWbm8AKgC-7N7f3AgHtNxUTwNuFEIwz7dQMD1TiXUtcMyeI5qbLaxB0WO1GjvuYlEQVTOdQ)
- **Poor sleep and immune response:** Alcohol disrupts restorative sleep cycles and triggers inflammation, leaving you exhausted and foggy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF10UmqLeFKhHH13pKVYqbtJpy6hu6V0lvOpsK-XkaeCTWASHqmTx0aICImkuCvDf02xIEfVpU1gmfl-Znu3oglJWBg2d7_9D1hxQ5UETpKVDPYjN0LUVo34bblWbm8AKgC-7N7f3AgHtNxUTwNuFEIwz7dQMD1TiXUtcMyeI5qbLaxB0WO1GjvuYlEQVTOdQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF16IUyzWty7LnebKgE-4aM-ylQ19USBealrtmYHMjHts_QuhVMVZPAo8er8-Q2q4VH4JZLjHE9Q2yJXrvhyvsfGEjX75GjMHFV4H_4LJ8R52pGy8vw3Tq4P2ZZbwxK8qE6RS_yxiFM9M8Bg2rzmqrFRhxtxMUeNOnENPdM7WefZysGNt2XgSnjnd3grmDcgsunj8fdniTgGaK62MQADcjHruf9b9hp6Smet5zVXvLKOuGtqxgC5ln984)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXHXfv5R-ZmtnFzTufhaDbr0bOoExKhAD3ok7ssUdjmLKmrF2YN7RmdP1os9nvR4_HvWBnOAV5h9tJ86Kr60ES8K2Wga6Ar0RR3DtA8VfyMftiaGnrQK1il-ddSKpWChDe)
- **Age and individual factors:** Tolerance, metabolism, genetics, and age can influence how quickly you bounce back . Extra rest may also help recovery, as suggested by a single user's comment on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF12UXQZjezKQjJEzGg5q89Jxrfz9wt9TBlCU15zzgsyQOmx330k3x2czMF1MTHqQb8Dpggwej66QnMONDhF1uR7cJyVQBg83h2JlzKr2OrCYgWiAud2A2BXJwrApqreJ9RnMwISn4slp4OVs3Hc07j-Fouye434a6HrR6obvOTZ8LvPqHHCTtHoKx8mg8WgyNts5WLBo1DzFX) who noted that sleeping for 11 hours helped them feel fine the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF12y-MbInaU29FeC0lFdwX3MBOdiW-Wm8ed8X1ZF0mXdDmGbC36BZ2BenfghWjsebve6zGLFrxZN0O5ea4St-llLhAKs05Z62_GPUOmfToE9xRelK4kDQTNRadDFGMSj6qON6vuzaPxiecvprBFugwcggilLPEWWo6TODfB5rlTUm7HZJlqxqe4TBElcPhbhj7OpPnUmyFu0SuzW0JMA6HKoR2Lo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF10UmqLeFKhHH13pKVYqbtJpy6hu6V0lvOpsK-XkaeCTWASHqmTx0aICImkuCvDf02xIEfVpU1gmfl-Znu3oglJWBg2d7_9D1hxQ5UETpKVDPYjN0LUVo34bblWbm8AKgC-7N7f3AgHtNxUTwNuFEIwz7dQMD1TiXUtcMyeI5qbLaxB0WO1GjvuYlEQVTOdQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF12UXQZjezKQjJEzGg5q89Jxrfz9wt9TBlCU15zzgsyQOmx330k3x2czMF1MTHqQb8Dpggwej66QnMONDhF1uR7cJyVQBg83h2JlzKr2OrCYgWiAud2A2BXJwrApqreJ9RnMwISn4slp4OVs3Hc07j-Fouye434a6HrR6obvOTZ8LvPqHHCTtHoKx8mg8WgyNts5WLBo1DzFX)
- **Other causes:** In people who drink heavily or regularly, symptoms lasting a couple of days can sometimes overlap with mild alcohol withdrawal rather than a simple hangover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXqiNNpoyUjH4aKj3jlChIENQXS3X3Rf49MB7rBqcp0QygsB1dqfODqi3quawPIBc2U8NdHK93KGCT6g2nla1uNQwQyc4Ri-gZP5VAp-E3IYiTOCAoXjtpl89MN9F05wctCcyNyRl1DQmamfue___-T8ltRjW7PA)

### What Helps

- **Give it time:** Only time lets your body clear byproducts, rehydrate, and heal.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF18kFy2B7PlnpBXjf8cLx8uVKSHy0gyKciwCmFbbDZRUrzCE476y0P-3FrBx9C81g43qKMqaq2GaV7KUYEerZy1T7RymK1yXqg0GazXd43dbHre5pr_zkASU-OPR5LeOqwuBTVzsi8pGsHSsDUBhzl4U5w5mHSQviMdX-R37aMniL)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgfnSpQFpcKvXMpQuO0iKqKQ-EMHXLgcXPUXijtZihWa5uhDZFCwz9k4WAUBhTZTY3cfdRBG69dmjBLsyBe-uQTncHqQjErRcAcKK1H2deKQH_Y9Op74BEiDLVfJfCwAd8ggkrLIfMVL6ci-PiPqQxS5Yaw)
- **Hydrate and eat lightly:** Sip water or electrolyte drinks and eat bland foods like toast, crackers, or broth as your stomach tolerates them.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgfnSpQFpcKvXMpQuO0iKqKQ-EMHXLgcXPUXijtZihWa5uhDZFCwz9k4WAUBhTZTY3cfdRBG69dmjBLsyBe-uQTncHqQjErRcAcKK1H2deKQH_Y9Op74BEiDLVfJfCwAd8ggkrLIfMVL6ci-PiPqQxS5Yaw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXsJwDnilSGbA6zm49cgWBulUm1y6Cu2atWDvZx6ris3xANwdpqIDit7Qobikl0i0jBD2-stcO27sv5HpI_tsGZJIIEsx_dxdgp2E3Gv_YKIRni_hURiQ_3gW0tbLYDc1yDg)
- **Rest and avoid more alcohol:** Prioritize sleep and skip "hair of the dog," which prolongs recovery. (Be cautious with pain relievers like acetaminophen alongside alcohol due to liver strain.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXsJwDnilSGbA6zm49cgWBulUm1y6Cu2atWDvZx6ris3xANwdpqIDit7Qobikl0i0jBD2-stcO27sv5HpI_tsGZJIIEsx_dxdgp2E3Gv_YKIRni_hURiQ_3gW0tbLYDc1yDg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF18kFy2B7PlnpBXjf8cLx8uVKSHy0gyKciwCmFbbDZRUrzCE476y0P-3FrBx9C81g43qKMqaq2GaV7KUYEerZy1T7RymK1yXqg0GazXd43dbHre5pr_zkASU-OPR5LeOqwuBTVzsi8pGsHSsDUBhzl4U5w5mHSQviMdX-R37aMniL)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgfnSpQFpcKvXMpQuO0iKqKQ-EMHXLgcXPUXijtZihWa5uhDZFCwz9k4WAUBhTZTY3cfdRBG69dmjBLsyBe-uQTncHqQjErRcAcKK1H2deKQH_Y9Op74BEiDLVfJfCwAd8ggkrLIfMVL6ci-PiPqQxS5Yaw)

Dehydration and stomach irritation: Alcohol acts as a diuretic and irritates the stomach lining, leading to ongoing fluid loss, headaches, and nausea. Poor sleep and immune response: Alcohol disrupts restorative sleep cycles and triggers inflammation, leaving you exhausted and foggy. Age and individual factors: Tolerance, metabolism, genetics, and age can influence how quickly you bounce back. Other causes: In people who drink heavily or regularly, symptoms lasting a couple of days can sometimes overlap with mild alcohol withdrawal rather than a simple hangover.

items.title: What Helps
items.text: Give it time: Only time lets your body clear byproducts, rehydrate, and heal. Hydrate and eat lightly: Sip water or electrolyte drinks and eat bland foods like toast, crackers, or broth as your stomach tolerates them. Rest and avoid more alcohol: Prioritize sleep and skip "hair of the dog," which prolongs recovery. (Be cautious with pain relievers like acetaminophen alongside alcohol due to liver strain.)
